name: Burlada / Burlata (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the arms of Burlada (three fleurs-de-lis on red, timbred with a helmet and mantling).
history: Municipal flag of Burlada/Burlata; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
